description: Calling us every morning to see whether a value moved? Watch the record instead. Give a dataset slug and a record id and this hands back one URL that answers "has it changed" in a single conditional request — send back the ETag and a 304 means nothing we hold about that record has changed, while a 200 carries the current values, the source page and the publisher's verbatim sentence, plus the before and after for the datasets that record one. The same feed is served as Atom for a feed reader. Works for any published record. We do not push and store nothing about you: the URL is derived from the dataset and record id, so this makes your poll cheap and definite, it does not notify you.

record_id.description: The record's id, as search_records, find_fact, get_record and changed_since all return it.

name: watch
title: Watch one record for changes
